Choose PROPOSE only if a cautious conditional direction is supported, otherwise INSUFFICIENT. Copy fact ids and their value_digest exactly, including the complete result/cost and limitations claims. All advice and expected mechanisms are HYPOTHESIS, never observed causation or a universally best action. Choose one or two allowed directions and appropriate basis_refs. Conditions must use F001 and F002. Do not write free prose, numeric guesses, identifiers, ranking advice, coordinates or stability explanations. The schema example illustrates format only, not a mandatory positive answer. There is no repair or retry.
